sourceHeader.time: 1 Reaction, when an allied creature within you could reach with your movement would take damage.
sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Bukijutsu Fire Release, Barrier

system.description:
As an ally begins to succumb to peril, you move quickly to protect them. Select an allied creature whose space you could reach with your movement speed.

You morph your body into smoke and dart towards them like a bullet of smoke, before reforming, occupying their space and pushing the allied creature into a space that can hold them no further than 10 feet way.

If this jutsu triggered as a result of damage dealt as a result of an attack, the attack automatically hits you and you raise both arms up and form a smoke barrier that intercepts the damage, with 2d6 + 8 temporary hit points.

If this jutsu was used in response to a failed save, the creature you protected no longer suffers the effects of a failed save, and you roll the saving throw in their place, with a rank of Mastery to the saving throw result.

If you reduce the attacks damage to 0, or succeed the saving throw, you respond being able to cast a Iburi Hijutsu with a casting time of 1 Action, targeting the triggering creature.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the temporary hit points gained by 1d6 + 2, or the save bonus by +1.
